prerequisites: Basic knowledge of electrical engineering, such as Kirchhoff's laws and complex AC and three-phase current calculation.
Refreshing fundamental relationships concerning magnetic fields is particularly helpful for preparation.

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the structure and constructive peculiarities of various machine types.
Present the electromagnetic operating principle of various machine types.
Derive the operating behavior from the electromagnetic operating principle and describe it using an analytical equation model.
Perform fundamental practical tests on electrical machines.
Master the analytical and graphical evaluation of measurement protocols.
Present test results professionally and appropriately for the audience using current visualization media.
Transfer the electromagnetic operating principle of electromagnetic energy converters into analytical calculation methods for investigating various operating states.
Numerically investigate detailed questions regarding specific operating points of machines and determine operating parameters.
Utilize a toolkit for independently addressing drive technology issues within the framework of specific energy technology and mechatronics questions.
Compare application limits and potentials of various machine types to critically review their suitability for specific drive tasks.
Recognize the necessity of integrating electrical machines into electrical drive systems.
Evaluate the suitability of various machine types for different drive types.
Assess questions regarding the sustainability of different electric drives for specific drive tasks.
Classify and critically reflect on common marketing terms and statements regarding electric drives.
Technically classify new drive concepts within the energy transition process and electromobility.
Question societal statements and assessments related to new drive concepts.
Recognize the necessities for integrating electrical machines into electrical systems and derive system-relevant design questions.
Describe the electrical machine as the main component of an electrical drive system and extract critical interface parameters to other system components.
Transfer the methodology acquired for implementing real energy converters into analytical calculation models to other electrical engineering, especially energy technology, systems.
Prepare, present, discuss, and defend results of selected metrological analyses and calculations in a group and as a team.
Present results at a level suitable for communication with customers or superiors after entering professional life.

syllabus_topics: Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of DC machines
Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of three-phase synchronous machines
Structure, operating principle and operating behavior of three-phase asynchronous machines
Laboratory practical with experiments on the operating behavior of DC, three-phase asynchronous and three-phase synchronous machines
assessment_rules: The preferred examination format is a 30-minute oral examination, but a two-hour written exam is also possible. As part of the practical training, a total of three experiment reports must be prepared in small groups. The graded examination performance duration for the oral exam is as per the general part of the examination regulations; for the written exam, it is as per the currently valid study regulations. The ungraded examination performance consists of three experiments.
